How much would it cost to go on a weed tour in Colorado?

You can get a flight to Denver for less than $400. If you watch the deals, you can get one for under $200. There are plenty of Hotels, but if you are on a budget, then you'll want to stay in the Denver area. You can get an AirBNB for about $50/night. Map the AirBNB and make sure you are staying on public transit routes and fairly close to the city. Denver has great public transportation, so you should not have a problem getting around. There are legal marijuana dispensories all over the place. You simply need to be 21, have proper ID, and cash. Some will take debit cards, but as you are from out of state, I would stick with cash.

You are allowed up to 1 OZ total for personal use while in Colorado, but I would not suggest buying anywhere near that much. They sell as little as a gram, and you will have a a ton of choices, so buy a little bit of a few. There are basically 3 types; Indica, Sativa, and Hybrid. The Hybrids are some combination of Indica and Sativa. Indica will put you to sleep, and Sativa will give you more of a body high.

Grams cost about $15 - $20 depending on the quality. Some even more. Gauge accordingly. You do not want to have to throw away $200 worth of weed. DO NOT take any with you back to the airport. Your shit will get checked when leaving, and your home state will arrest you if you get caught.

All in all you should be able to go spend a week for less than $1000.

EDIT; One last note - It is totally legal, so don't worry about having to hang out at the hotel to smoke. You can pretty much smoke anywhere outside without issue. They also have plenty of edibles, but again, don't buy too much, you can't take it with you.
Downtown is totally walkable. the 16th Street Mall has free buses, and you can pretty much walk all of downtown. I used to live downtown. Plus, like I said, the transit system is awesome and cheap.
